why: All three checks confirm the finding; it survives, with one sub-clause corrected. The whole line is three sentences and neither of the other two reverses anything: 'Set `type` to "command" and point `command` to a script path or an inline shell command. For a full walkthrough of creating a script, see [Build a status line step by step](#build-a-status-line-step-by-step).' The claimed behaviour is also fully supported by the page: :51 shows `padding`, :67 'The optional `padding` field ... Defaults to `0`', :69 'The optional `refreshInterval` field re-runs your command every N seconds ... The minimum is `1`', :71 `hideVimModeIndicator`, :137 'Claude Code runs your script and pipes JSON session data to it via stdin', and :169-198 enumerate the stdin payload. (2) CITED STATE ACCURATE. `grep -rain -e '"statusLine"' -e "'statusLine'" -e 'statusLine:' --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.json' packages apps` returns 0 (re-run with -a, node_modules filtered). A wider case-insensitive `grep -rain statusline` over all source outside node_modules/.git/.references/docs returns exactly two lines, both the claimed unrelated local: packages/shared/src/sessions/storage.ts:901 `const statusLine = lines.find(l => l.startsWith('**Status:**'));` and :902, a plan-markdown parser. packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts:2275 reads exactly `{ externalKind: 'settings', field: 'settings', defaultPath: 'settings.json' }`, the last row of CLAUDE_RETAINED_SURFACE_FIELDS, consumed by addClaudeRetainedSurfaceDeferrals, which pushes a deferral row and interprets no keys. (3) ONE LAYER UP AND ONE DOWN BOTH HOLD. Nothing upstream honours it by another route: packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:2994 states in shipped source 'we have no reader for `~/.claude/settings.json`', and the Claude backend actively moves that scope out of reach - packages/shared/src/agent/options.ts:204-206 redirects CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR per Workspace so 'a hand-written `~/.claude/settings.json` stops reaching the subprocess', called a deliberate isolation decision. The Claude Agent SDK subprocess we do spawn has no TUI, so it renders no status line either. Sibling-subsystem check: the only status-shaped surface in the fork is apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/input/ToolbarStatusSlot.tsx, a fixed priority overlay for the escape-to-interrupt hint and browser-session state - no user command, no stdin JSON, not configurable; apps/cli is a 'Terminal client for Nessy Desktop server' with no TUI footer (no ink, no footer renderer). So the consequence is true independently of the identifier. NOT one of the nine dated owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/isManagedModelAllowed, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath, listSessionSummaries) - I read all nine. Not a rebrand, gateway or dropped-subscription product difference either. ONE CORRECTION, which does not overturn the row: the third sentence of the claimed our-state ('so a plugin-shipped statusLine is also inert') is not a divergence. plugins.md:298 says verbatim 'Plugins can include a `settings.json` file at the plugin root to apply default configuration when the plugin is enabled. Currently, only the `agent` and `subagentStatusLine` keys are supported.' - a top-level `statusLine` in a plugin's settings.json is ignored by Claude Code too, so our deferral of that file costs us `agent` and `subagentStatusLine` (f053, f206), not `statusLine`. ALSO NOTE FOR RANKING, NOT REFUTATION: this gap is already recorded twice. The parity audit, the source of truth, lists it at 2026-07-25-nessy-claude-parity-audit.md:1720 under 'Minor, no row, listed for completeness ... keybindings, statusline, deep links', and the deviation register at :448 carries a 'not implemented' row noting Nessy has no third-party loader for the status line because it is not a capability kind.
